title: FisherDistill: Diffusion Distribution Distillation via Closed-Form Fisher Critics
abstract: arXiv:2611.07604v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion distillation have enabled high-quality image generation in only one or a few network function evaluations (NFEs). Despite their efficiency, aggressively distilled generators often retain a residual distribution gap from their multi-step teachers, motivating recent methods to introduce adversarial refinement with a learned discriminator. In this work, we ask whether such refinement necessarily requires a learned adversarial discriminator. We introduce \textbf{FisherDistill}, a simple alternative based on Fisher linear discriminant analysis. Using intermediate representations from the frozen teacher, we estimate the first- and second-order statistics of real and generated samples and derive a closed-form Fisher direction that maximally separates their feature distributions relative to within-class variation. This direction provides a lightweight refinement signal that complements the original distillation obj

translated_title: FisherDistill：基于闭式Fisher判别器的扩散分布蒸馏
translated_abstract: 扩散蒸馏领域的最新进展使得高质量图像生成仅需一次或少数几次网络函数评估（NFE）即可实现。尽管这些方法效率很高，但经过激进蒸馏的生成器与多步教师模型之间往往仍存在残余的分布差距，这促使近期方法引入基于学习判别器的对抗性精细化手段。在本工作中，我们探究这样的精细化是否必须依赖学习得到的对抗判别器。我们提出了FisherDistill，一种基于Fisher线性判别分析的简单替代方案。利用冻结教师模型的中间表示，我们估计真实样本与生成样本的一阶和二阶统计量，并推导出一个闭式的Fisher方向，该方向相对于类内变异能够最大程度地分离两者的特征分布。这一方向提供了一种轻量级的精细化信号，可作为原始蒸馏目标的补充。
tldr: 提出FisherDistill方法，通过冻结教师模型的中间表示计算闭式Fisher判别方向，无需训练对抗判别器即可对蒸馏后的扩散生成器进行轻量级的分布精细化。
en_tdlr: FisherDistill derives a closed-form Fisher discriminant direction from the frozen teacher's intermediate representations, enabling lightweight distribution refinement of distilled diffusion generators without training a learned adversarial discriminator.
